ebay_us_2026_general.description: eBay US managed payments, most categories. Final value fee is tiered with a fixed per-order amount; payment processing is included in the final value fee. Buyer-side sales tax uses a representative blended marketplace-facilitator rate.
ebay_us_2026_general.notes: tax_rate is a representative blended US state rate for marketplace-facilitator collection; shipping_cost is a representative carrier rate for a small parcel.

paypal_gs_us_2026.description: Direct peer-to-peer sale settled with PayPal Goods and Services. The receiving seller pays the processing fee; no marketplace final value fee and no facilitator tax collection.
paypal_gs_us_2026.notes: Processing fee modeled on the seller side because the receiver pays it.

local_cash_pickup.description: Local meetup with cash payment: no platform fees, no payment processing, no shipping, and no buyer protection.
local_cash_pickup.notes: Zero-fee channel; the realism trade-off is the absence of any platform protection.
